plan.description: Read-only planning and design reasoning (Gemini 4 Argon). Use for architecture, policy decisions, task decomposition and plan reviews before code is written.

build.description: Implementation agent (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). Executes an approved plan, writes code, runs targeted tests.

planner.description: Subagent that researches a spec or issue against the current codebase and writes a step-by-step implementation plan. Reasoning-heavy.

implementer.description: Subagent that executes one approved plan step: code edits, migrations, targeted tests. Cheap model; needs a precise handoff prompt.

explore.description: Fast read-only codebase search and summaries

reviewer.description: Reviews diffs for correctness, types and regressions
